# Incident Report — MTA 2024-09-04 Traffic Analysis Exercise

## Victim Host
| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| IPv4 | **172.17.0.99** |
| MAC | **18:3d:a2:b6:8d:c4** |
| Windows hostname | **DESKTOP-RNVO9AT** (domain: bepositive.com) |
| Logged-in user | **afletcher** |

MAC confirmed via ARP (172.17.0.99 is at 18:3d:a2:b6:8d:c4). Hostname confirmed via DHCP option 12 and NBNS. Username confirmed via Kerberos `CNameString` (`afletcher`) in AS-REQ/TGS traffic between 172.17.0.99 and the domain controller 172.17.0.17 (WIN-CTL9XBQ9Y19).

## Malware Family
**Koi Stealer** (Win32/Koi Stealer). **Attribution: signature-confirmed** — Suricata/ET alert `ETPRO TROJAN Win32/Koi Stealer CnC Checkin (POST) M2` fired 48 times on POST traffic from 172.17.0.99 to 79.124.78.197. Independently corroborated by behavior: `ET INFO GENERIC SUSPICIOUS POST to Dotted Quad with Fake Browser 1` and a spoofed IE7 user-agent on a machine that everywhere else identifies as native Windows 10/Edge traffic.

## Delivery
- 172.17.0.99 established a TLS session (frame 1279, SNI `www.bellantonicioccolato.it`, IP 46.254.34.201) at t≈153.5s, ~30 seconds before the first C2 checkin — consistent with drive-by/malvertising payload delivery immediately preceding infection. No DNS query for this domain appears in the capture (resolved before the capture window or via a cached/prior lookup), so the domain-to-IP binding is grounded only in the TLS SNI field, not DNS.
- Traffic is TLS-encrypted end to end, so no downloaded file object or hash could be recovered from this delivery session.

## Command-and-Control
- C2 beacon: 96 HTTP POSTs to `http://79.124.78.197/foots.php` between t=155.9s and t=3564.6s (~57 minutes), accessed by bare IP (no DNS lookup for 79.124.78.197 anywhere in the capture — matches the "dotted quad" alert).
- Beacon body format (frame 1668, decoded from `application/octet-stream`): `101|30168213-3be0-a751-81a0-cf3b228c8654|5LHtVruc|<base64 payload>` — bot ID, session GUID, campaign token, and encrypted data.
- A secondary panel endpoint was also used: `GET /index.php?id=&subid=qIOuKk7U` (frame 2227) and `POST /index.php` (frame 2236). The server response to the GET (frame 2232), decoded from hex, is:
  `HckDcK0czXjaq48jVHNn|qIOuKk7U|http://79.124.78.197/index.php|`
  — a tasking/config response referencing itself, confirming `79.124.78.197` as the operator's C2 panel.
- User-agent used for all C2 traffic: `Mozilla/4.0 (compatible; MSIE 7.0; Windows NT 10.0; WOW64; Trident/7.0; ...)` — spoofed/static, does not match real browser traffic elsewhere in the capture.

## Grounded IOCs

  "attribution_confidence": "signature-confirmed",
  "iocs": [
    {"type": "c2_endpoint", "value": "79.124.78.197:80", "evidence": "96x ETPRO TROJAN Win32/Koi Stealer CnC Checkin (POST) alerts; HTTP POST /foots.php and /index.php from victim, frames 1668-5077, t=155.9s-3564.6s"},
